'''Camron Gelorik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Sundari (planet)|Sundari]].

==Biography==
During the [[Garosian civil war]], Camron Gelorik was a radical [[Sundari (planet)|Sundari]] leader. However, when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established an official presence on [[Garos IV]] in [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]], Gelorik allied with his former Garosian enemies to fight the Empire.<ref name="Turning Point" />
